entities.name: St. Aloysius Chapel
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Aloysius Chapel, or the chapel of St. Aloysius College, is a Catholic chapel in Mangalore in the state of Karnataka in southwest India. The chapel is situated in the heart of the city on the Lighthouse Hill.
